title: Fix wayland event thread hanging on exit

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
The call to wl_display_roundtrip meant to wake up the event thread is not guaranteed to generate a poll event and wake it up.

This commit adds a wakeup pipe `destroy` can use to ensure the event thread wakes up and sees the thread_done signal.

## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #123059

## Additional information

`WaylandThread::destroy()` was relying on `wl_display_roundtrip` to wake up the polling thread, but that doesn't happen deterministically.  There was essentially a race between the main thread and the polling thread to read the "done" reply, and if the polling thread lost the race it  would get stuck in `poll` forever and godot would never shut down.

I added a wakeup pipe `WaylandThread::destroy()` could use to deterministically wake up the polling thread. An alternative (much simpler) solution would have been to simply add a timeout to the poll, but then we'd have to wait for the timeout when the thread loses the race instead of instantly shutting down (plus having to uselessly wake up during runtime).

In fixing this, I also fixed an existing bug in the same code where there were some `if (poll_fd.revents | POLLIN)` checks, that were almost certainly typos meant to be doing `if (poll_fd.revents & POLLIN)`.
